bk.none: No backup has been made yet.
bk.staleHint: Back up now, and set a second folder on a USB drive or a synced cloud folder.
bk.auto: Back up automatically while data changes
bk.everyHint: 5 to 1440. A backup is made only if something changed.
bk.onClose: Back up when the program closes
bk.secondHint: A USB drive, or a Google Drive / OneDrive / Dropbox folder, keeps a copy if this computer fails.
bk.emptyBody: Press "Back up now" to make the first one.
bk.deleteBody: The file is removed from the backup folder. Your current data is not touched.
bk.restoreGo: Replace my data with this backup
bk.restoreSummary: Backup of {when} from {business}: {products} products, {customers} customers, {sales} invoices.
bk.restoreWarn: Everything entered after {when} will be replaced. You will have to sign in again.
bk.restoreSafety: A safety copy of your current data is made first, so this can be undone.
bk.secondWarn: The second folder could not be written. The main backup is safe.
bk.diagBody: Makes one ZIP with program versions, database health, counts, settings and the error log. Send it to support when something goes wrong.
bk.diagPrivacy: It contains no customers, suppliers, products, prices, users or passwords.
rec.banner: The data file was damaged, so the backup of {when} was restored automatically. Entries made after that time are not in it.
bk.freshBody: Deletes this shop (products, stock, sales, purchases, customers, dues, money, users and settings) and opens the first-time setup, as on a new computer.
bk.freshWarn: All data of this shop will be deleted, and everyone will have to set up the shop again.
bk.freshYesHelp: The backup is saved in the Backups list. You can restore it later if you change your mind.
bk.freshWipe: Also delete the old backups, exports and saved invoices on this computer
bk.freshNoUndo: This cannot be undone, except from an older backup in the list.
bk.freshNoUndoAll: This cannot be undone. No copy of the old shop will be left on this computer.
bk.freshDone: The shop was deleted. Set up the new shop.
bk.freshDoneBackup: Backup {name} saved. Set up the new shop.
